newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine industrial growth boosted by cars, tires.
newsitem.headline: Argentine industrial growth boosted by cars, tires.

text.p: Argentina's 11.1 percent industrial production growth in September was boosted by synthetic fibers, tires, cars, agrochemicals and flour, the INDEC statistics institute said Tuesday.
Synthetic fibers output was up 42.7 percent, tires 33.4 percent, flour 33 percent, cars 33 percent and agrochemical products 26.4 percent.
Plastics, steel, laminates and soft drinks all grew more than 10 percent, a chart showed, but no precise figures were released for those items.
The two items with the worst drop were beer, down 16.1 percent, and liquor, 14.9 percent. Pharmaceutical products dropped more than five percent.
